H04-01: Inspection of distinct font families used across the UI.
Pass: The total number of distinct primary font families is 3 or fewer.
Fail: More than 3 distinct font families are used.
1. Collect font families from injected scripts, inline styles, and CSS vars.
2. Parse <style> blocks for font-family applied to active selectors.
3. Normalize names exclude system fonts, generic serif/sans-serif, and icons.
If more than 3 distinct font families are used on the page:
- Consolidate the design to use a maximum of 3 font families (e.g., primary, heading, and accent). Define them globally using CSS variables.
